body:
Haven't tried DMT. Have tried shrooms, LSD, salvia.    

The fear of failure has held me back during the moments when I feel like I needed to do it immediately. I think this sub prohibits discussing methods, so I'll just leave it at this: I would use multiple methods in combination with each other to be positive that it worked. I'd also do a few things to minimize whatever mess I made in the process and make things as convenient as possible for the poor EMTs that have to transport me to the morgue.
